title: More detailed image-based communications with emotion (rockets, troop movements)

tellings.quote: >> Very like pictures, images. Yeah, these communications they were they were much more uh colorful.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, hired him to talk to aliens, says that between 1990 and 1993, at a place he calls Base 2, the messages he received in his mind turned into detailed pictures with feeling in them. He says they were "very like pictures, images" and "much more colorful," showing things like rockets and troop movements, which would mean the contact had grown richer than simple words.
